name: notion-live-translate
description: Face-to-face live translation on iPhone, logged to Notion (N-Translator)

SONIOX_API_KEY.description: Soniox の API キー（console.soniox.com で発行）/ Soniox API key

ACCESS_KEY.description: 翻訳画面を開くための合言葉。16文字以上（20文字以上のランダムな文字列がおすすめ）/ Passphrase to open the app, at least 16 characters (20+ random recommended)

NOTION_TOKEN.description: Notion の内部接続の API トークン（ntn_ で始まる）/ Notion internal connection token (starts with ntn_)
